title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 26
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 26: the song of the strong city, perfect peace for the trusting, and the dead who will live.

questions.text: In which land will the song "We have a strong city" be sung in that day?
questions.explanation: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: "We have a strong city."

answers.text: The land of Egypt
The land of Judah
The land of Assyria
The land of Moab

questions.text: Why are the gates to be opened?
questions.explanation: The gates are to be opened so that the righteous nation may enter, the one which keeps faith.

answers.text: So the king may ride in with his army
So the merchants may bring their goods
So the exiles may flee the city
So the righteous nation which keeps faith may enter

questions.text: Whom will Yahweh keep in perfect peace?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will keep whoever's mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in him.

answers.text: Whoever's mind is steadfast, because he trusts in him
Whoever offers many sacrifices on the altar
Whoever dwells on high in the lofty city
Whoever fasts and mourns before the gates

questions.text: Why should people trust in Yahweh forever?
questions.explanation: The song says to trust in Yahweh forever, for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.

answers.text: For his mercy endures forever
For he made the heavens and the earth
For in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock
For he keeps covenant with his servants

questions.text: What happens when Yahweh's judgments are in the earth?
questions.explanation: When his judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

answers.text: The nations flee to the islands
The inhabitants of the world learn righteousness
The wicked are converted at once
The mountains tremble and melt

questions.text: What do the people say about the other lords who have had dominion over them?
questions.explanation: Other lords besides Yahweh have had dominion over them, but they will only acknowledge Yahweh's name.

answers.text: They will only acknowledge Yahweh's name
They will serve those lords forever
They will make a covenant with those lords
They never had any other lords

questions.text: To what does the chapter compare the people's condition before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Just as a woman with child near her delivery is in pain and cries out in her pangs, so the people have been before Yahweh.

answers.text: A ship tossed back and forth on the waves
A vineyard left without rain in summer
A soldier fleeing wounded from the battle
A woman with child crying out in her pangs

questions.text: What did the people give birth to, it seems?
questions.explanation: They were with child and in pain, but they gave birth, it seems, only to wind, and worked no deliverance in the earth.

answers.text: A ruler
A new nation
Only wind
Fire and smoke

questions.text: What are those who dwell in the dust told to do?
questions.explanation: The verse says: "Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust," for your dead shall live and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.

answers.text: Hide themselves from the light
Awake and sing
Keep silence before Yahweh
Mourn and put on sackcloth

questions.text: What are the people told to do until the indignation is past?
questions.explanation: They are told to enter their rooms, shut their doors behind them, and hide themselves for a little moment until the indignation is past.

answers.text: Enter their rooms, shut their doors, and hide for a little moment
Stand on the city walls and watch for the enemy
Go out with songs to meet the enemy at the gate
Gather in the temple courts to fast and to pray
